description: The connected person's own bookings at WaitApp venues and organisers: stays, tables, spaces, services, catering requests, and activity and event bookings. Upcoming first, then recent ones. Each has its venue, when it is (in the venue's own time), its status, and where something is still owed the amount and a paymentLink to WaitApp's own payment page; activities also carry the meeting point, what to bring, whether it is going ahead and the cancellation policy. Entry QR codes and other people's personal details are never returned. Orders are listed by list_my_orders, and a booking made without signing in is found with check_booking_status.
name: list_my_bookings
title: List my bookings
